messages:
Alyssa (partnerships): Heads-up: we're coordinating a breaking SDK bump (v3 -> v4) tied to a joint marketplace update and a hardware certification pass. Need to draft a partner-first rollout that minimizes breakage. Who can help map partner constraints? :thinking_face:
Ravi (partner-success): I have a short list: CloudMarket, HWCo, SI-Delta, IntegrateX. CloudMarket needs a 5-week approval window, HWCo needs vendor test harness + 7-week cert window, SI-Delta wants a private beta.
Jordan (eng): From eng side, idea: 1) provide a backwards-compat flag (compat_level: "v3"), 2) ship a temporary shim module available via private registry, 3) publish automated test suite partners can run. Flags can live for 10w.
Maya (legal): If we're publishing a shim through marketplace, legal needs to review distribution terms and liability. I can review in 3 business days if we get the draft. Also check export compliance for HWCo binaries.
Sanjay (devex): I'll own the partner preview packaging. Plan: private npm/pypi feed + archive with compatibility notes. CLI helper: `ri-migrate check --from v3 --to v4` and a short `migration.md`. Can include a small telemetry opt-in: `compat_telemetry: true` so we can triage partner failures.
Alyssa (partnerships): Love that. Can we keep the public deprecation poster minimal? Suggested cadence: partner preview (2026-05-12), joint partner announcement (2026-05-26), public deprecation notice (2026-06-30), v3 sunset after 12 weeks from public. Any blockers?
Jordan (eng): One blocker: IntegrateX uses long-polling and a custom client that hits a low-level API; shim might not cover edge behavior. Need IntegrateX to run the CI suite. Ravi can we get their engineering contact?
Ravi (partner-success): I'll ping Sam at IntegrateX today and request an integration point + sample payloads.
Maya (legal): Also confirm whether the marketplace allows bundled compatibility shims; some marketplaces frown on runtime-injected shims. I'll flag this in review.
release-bot: Release window reserved: partner-preview 2026-05-12 -> canary 2026-05-12..2026-06-02 -> public 2026-06-30.
Alyssa (partnerships): Action items: 1) Ravi: secure IntegrateX payloads + partner engineering contact by 2026-04-18. 2) Jordan: automated test suite + CI runner by 2026-04-25. 3) Sanjay: partner-preview packages + `migration.md` by 2026-04-28. 4) Maya: legal sign-off on marketplace shim + export check by 2026-04-20. 5) Alyssa: partner comms + embargo text by 2026-04-19. React with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
Jordan (eng): :white_check_mark: I'll start the CI harness and add a compatibility reporter that outputs a simple `PASS/FAIL` and telemetry snippet.
Sanjay (devex): :white_check_mark: packaging plan in progress. Will include example `ri-migrate` output and a small migration checklist.
Maya (legal): :white_check_mark: will start review, but need the shim distribution draft.
Ravi (partner-success): :white_check_mark: will request IntegrateX contact and align ETA.
Alyssa (partnerships): Great. Follow-ups: post test-suite results here as they come, and keep the private registry link pinned. If any partner requests longer runway we can offer a 2-phase migration with extended compat flag. Thanks team! :rocket:
